text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a prioritized list of user stories describing what users need. Every day, team members hold quick standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to review their work regularly, respond to feedback, and improve the product step by step. As a result, Agile helps teams deliver value faster and adapt more easily to change.
